roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/settings/) with this contract beside it, and the billing-schedule and integration-settings examples it uses into components/patterns/ (kept if you already have them). You own the copies: replace the demo data, drop the sections you don't need, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Settings shell example for one workspace (Northwind Studio). Wide: a settings SideNav on the canvas (Back to app, then Workspace: General, Billing, Team, Integrations, Security; You: Profile, Notifications, Sign-in) and the section on the inset panel, named by its PageHeader with a scope line that says who a change reaches. Below --grid-breakpoint-md: an index page of two kit LinkLists with a description per row, and Back to Settings on each section. General, Profile and Notifications end in one SaveBar; Security's sign-in rules (SSO, Require SSO, two-step for members) end in their own save row, then your sessions and a Danger zone with Delete workspace; Billing (plan, payment method, AI credits UsageMeter, invoices Table, billing schedule), Team (seats Meter, role filter, members Table) and Integrations act per card; Sign-in holds your password and two-factor. Billing overdue / loading / error, Team empty and invite Drawer, Sign-in 2FA off.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens

Section links live in the pattern's own settings SideNav (a nav named Settings): Back to app first, then a Workspace group and a You group built from SETTINGS_SECTIONS, with the current section marked (aria-current=page); they are not a Settings group in the app's nav

Below --grid-breakpoint-md, Settings is an index page of two kit LinkLists (one per group, each under its own heading, a description per row), not the app's nav Drawer; each section page has a Back to Settings step, and going back focuses the row you came from
No Breadcrumb at --grid-breakpoint-md and up: the marked nav row and the PageHeader title name the section; the PageHeader subtitle is the scope line (who a change reaches)

Stage look: the pattern renders layout-shell--inset itself (the settings SideNav on the canvas, the section on the inset card panel) and its own <main>, so don't wrap it in an app shell or another main

Page layout uses kit layout classes (layout-shell--inset, layout-canvas, layout-header, layout-content, layout-split*) and grid / layout tokens; no hard-coded columns, gutters, max-widths or breakpoints
Wrap every labeled input in Field; Switches in a table row get an accessible name that says the row and the channel
Status is a word in a kit Badge (Active, Invited, Paid, On, Off…), never colour alone
Billing charges come from the billing-schedule example (summary mode); do not build a second charges list
An overdue invoice is a kit Alert (danger) that says the invoice, the amount and what happens next; Pay now is then the one solid primary and Upgrade steps away
Danger actions sit in their own group after every card that saves

Delete workspace sits on Security, in a Danger zone (a kit Section heading) after every card that saves, in its own Card, as a danger action behind a kit AlertDialog where you type the name; Cancel returns focus to it

General, Profile and Notifications end in one kit SaveBar (Cancel and Save changes); Security's sign-in rules end in their own save row in the card (Cancel and Save sign-in rules); the other sections have no save bar and act per card
Integrations renders the integration-settings example; do not build a second integration form
Money arrives pre-formatted from your app; label example data as example
defaults: General is the default section when wide; the index page is the default when narrow. Route section from your URL (sectionHref gives each row a real link) or let the pattern keep it

Scope lines: "Workspace setting · applies to all 12 members" (plus who can edit, when wide) and "Personal setting · only changes it for you"; the index rows say what's inside (next charge, Okta SSO, Password · two-factor off)
headerActions sit on the title row, e.g. Ask (neutral sm Button with MessageCircle)
Controls are md 36 wide and lg 40 below --grid-breakpoint-md; General's labels sit left of the controls when wide
Team's Invite people is the PageHeader primary; the empty Team page moves it into the kit Empty
Invite people opens a right kit Drawer with Email addresses, Role and Message; Send invites is the Drawer's primary

Billing: Compare plans opens kit PricingPlans in a kit Drawer; AI credits is a kit UsageMeter whose Upgrade is the one solid primary; invoices are a kit Table (a ListView below --grid-breakpoint-md), then the billing schedule
Team: a seats Card with a kit Meter (seats count pending invites) and Add seats, search and a role Select filter, and members in a kit Table (a ListView with a row menu below --grid-breakpoint-md)
Billing loading shows Skeletons in the same Cards; a load error is an outlined kit Empty with Retry
Security has one solid primary, Save sign-in rules; Sign-in has none: Update password and Set up are outline
No motion beyond kit overlays (Drawer, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu), which honour reduced motion
snippet: <SettingsPattern section={section} onSectionChange={setSection} appHref="/" headerActions={<Ask />} onSave={save} onDeleteWorkspace={deleteWorkspace} />
